newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria expects $16 bln oil, gas exports in 2000.
newsitem.headline: Algeria expects $16 bln oil, gas exports in 2000.

text.p: Algeria forecast $16 billion receipts from oil and gas exports in 2000, the country's Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia said in an interview.

"With two gas pipelines (to Italy and Spain) and with the current oil production, based in a $16 per barrel, Algeria will get $16 billion in 2000," said Ouyahia in remarks quoted on Saturday by the Algerian newspaper L'Authentique.

The Algerian Trade Ministry said this week that oil and gas exports, which make up 94.4 percent of Algeria's total exports, were at $8.49 billion in the first three quarters of 1996 compared to $6.76 billion for the same period last year.
Gas and oil exports totalled $9.730 billion in 1995 against $8.485 billion in 1994, according to official figures.
